summary: Blind rubric review of both arms using the c1-c7 judge model
description:
Review both arms through scripts/review_dossiers.py against prompts/dossier/contracts/review-rubric.md.

Two things must hold or the comparison is confounded:
1. SAME judge model as the c1-c7 baseline. Swapping the judge changes the measurement, not the result.
2. BLIND. The rubric prompt takes work_label/field/prompt_version and no model field, so it is naturally blind — keep it that way, do not leak which arm produced a row.

The rubric requires stage_input: 'Never judge an output alone. If stage_input is missing, return insufficient-input rather than guessing.' Use review_dossiers.py show to reconstruct it.

Record per arm: accept rate, counts per code (GROUND, LEAK, COVERAGE, FORMAT, REGISTER, HEDGE, COMPARE), and template_defect rate.

DONE: every paired span reviewed in both arms, verdicts stored, and the per-code contingency table attached to this ticket.
